title: Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty
chapter: Chapter V: Of Offences Against Woman and Child
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine
ingredients: Woman subjected to cruelty by husband or relative of husband
Cruelty includes willful conduct driving woman to suicide or grave injury
Harassment with a view to coercing woman or relative to meet unlawful dowry demand

title: Dowry Death
chapter: Chapter V: Of Offences Against Woman and Child
punishment: Imprisonment not less than 7 years but which may extend to life
ingredients: Death of a woman caused by burns, bodily injury, or under unnatural circumstances
Death occurs within 7 years of marriage
Shown that soon before death she was subjected to cruelty or harassment by husband or relative for dowry

title: Punishment for murder
chapter: Chapter VI: Of Offences Affecting the Human Body
punishment: Death or imprisonment for life, and fine
ingredients: Act done with intention of causing death or bodily injury sufficient in ordinary course of nature to cause death

title: Attempt to murder
chapter: Chapter VI: Of Offences Affecting the Human Body
punishment: Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine; if hurt caused, imprisonment up to life
ingredients: Doing act with such intention or knowledge and under such circumstances that if death caused, would be murder
Overt act towards commission of murder

title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
chapter: Chapter XVII: Of Offences Against Property
punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine
ingredients: Fraudulently or dishonestly inducing person to deliver property or alter valuable security

title: Criminal breach of trust
chapter: Chapter XVII: Of Offences Against Property
punishment: Imprisonment up to 5 years or fine
ingredients: Entrustment of property or dominion over property
Dishonest misappropriation or conversion to own use

title: Criminal intimidation
chapter: Chapter XIX: Of Criminal Intimidation, Insult, Annoyance, Defamation
punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years or fine
ingredients: Threatening another with injury to person, reputation, or property
Intent to cause alarm or compel person to do act legally not bound to do
